content: We need to search templates with criteria. The description: carbonyl-ene reaction, intramolecular, breaking C=O (ketone) and C=C (alkene) to form C-O (hydroxyl) and C-C bond, forming five-membered ring. So functional_groups_broken: ['ketones','C-C double bonds']; functional_groups_formed: ['aliphatic hydroxyls','five-membered rings']; bonds_order_changed: maybe C=O to C-O (order change 2->1) and C=C to C-C (2->1). Also bonds formed: new C-C bond (maybe 6-6). bonds broken: maybe C=O and C=C. Let's try search with appropriate lists.
